LightningComponentBundle.description: US state choropleth (shade = measure) with optional proportional bubbles (second measure). Accepts state codes, state names, "Cumulus GA Branch 1" names or Cumulus region names. Click a state to filter the dashboard.

property.name: dimensionField
property.label: State / Region dimension
property.description: State code, state name, branch name or Cumulus region.

property.name: bubbleMeasureField
property.label: Bubble measure (optional)
property.description: Drives bubble size at each state's centroid.

property.name: format
property.label: Shade format
property.description: Number formatting for the shade measure.

property.name: bubbleFormat
property.label: Bubble format
property.description: Number formatting for the bubble measure.

property.name: lowColor
property.label: Low colour
property.description: Hex colour for the lowest value.

property.name: highColor
property.label: High colour
property.description: Hex colour for the highest value.

property.name: showLabels
property.label: Show state codes
property.description: Print the two-letter code on states that have data.
